Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

steps.output: "For ARC grids with a sparse colored motif embedded in a noisy 0/background-color field, a task may ask to find every translation where the motif's colored-cell mask lands entirely on zeros, then recolor those zero cells with the motif color. Preserve the original motif and every nonmatching cell. Match the original orientation only; do not rotate or reflect unless demos show otherwise. Ignore motif bounding-box cells that are not colored: the match condition is that all motif cells land on 0, not that the whole bounding box matches a fixed pattern. Overlapping matches should produce the union of their motif cells. Demonstrated with a 3-colored 4x5 mask: two same-orientation placements on zeros were recolored, including overlaps, and output differences exactly equaled the union. Another 6-cell 1 mask in a 0/9 field had three placements; the output was the motif color at all their cells. Previous examples also confirmed no rotated/reflected matches. Use demos to verify target background, motif color, and whether orientation changes are allowed. Practical caution: transcribing a grid with even one omitted cell can hide a valid match and produce an invalid-sized output; verify every row has the stated width before matching and before submission."
